# WILD LIFE instructions for GitHub Copilot

The canonical project rules are in **[AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md)**. Read and
follow them before editing. Follow the nearest nested `AGENTS.md` for
feature-specific constraints; do not substitute generic Angular advice for
this repository's existing architecture.

Use the committed source, `package.json`, `eslint.config.cjs` and
`.github/workflows/ci.yml` to resolve outdated assumptions. Make focused
changes, protect deterministic experiment replay and report validation
truthfully. Keep new conventions in `AGENTS.md` rather than duplicating them
here.
